_about: Trend tool settings. Every value is a PROPOSAL from the owner research paper (RP:<line>) or a lead choice, not a platform rule and not backtested. Change values here, never in code.

breakout_consecutive_days.source: RP:97 (three consecutive matched days above baseline)

coverage_min.source: RP:93 (suppress promotion under 90% of intended minutes)

max_gap_minutes.source: RP:93 (suppress promotion with a gap over 60 minutes)

emerging_lead_days.source: RP:97 (under 14 complete days of our history: emerging lead (n days), no g7)

fade_negative_weeks.source: RP:99 (two negative non-overlapping weekly changes plus a lower matched trough)

week_boundary.source: lead choice J004-T05; paper leaves 'complete days' undefined (I8)

min_interval_s.source: studio choice: low request rate; no verified public limit (RP:54)

batch_size.source: studio choice: keep small (RP:56); code caps it at 50, the documented maximum (sources.json roblox.games)

max_retry_after_s.source: stop instead of waiting longer than this for Retry-After

apple_max_retries.source: fact-check-outside.md §3 Apple: a 504 waits for the next day's run, no retry loops

youtube_search_daily_budget.source: studio choice under the 100 search.list/day quota (fact-check-outside.md §3); counted over any trailing 24 hours
